base_rate.reasoning: Sweden has won Eurovision 7 times out of 68 contests (1974, 1984, 1991, 1999, 2012, 2015, 2023), giving a base rate of 10.3%. However, for any single future year, we should consider the broader reference class of 'any country winning in a given year' which is 1/~40 participating countries = 2.5%. Sweden's historical success rate of 10.3% represents a 4.1x multiplier over random chance. Using a conservative base rate of 1.5% accounts for Sweden's strong track record while avoiding overconfidence.
